statements.text: Luv prefers Effect 4 for the yumeoi domain layer.
The Vectorize index used by yumeoi is named yumeoi-memories.
Anna works with Luv on the Aurora project at yumeoi.
The team decided to keep Effect out of React components.
API keys for yumeoi start with ym_ and are hashed in D1.
Luv likes dark mode in the editor at all times.
Sam reports to Luv on connector work for Gmail later.
Embeddings use Workers AI bge-m3 at 1024 dimensions.
Namespaces in Vectorize are the user id for each store.
Luv prefers oat milk in coffee rather than dairy milk.
We decided to use Durable Object SQLite FTS5 for keyword search.
Chat remains pinned to GPT-5.6 Luna at high reasoning effort.
Luv is a teammate of Cursor agents on the yumeoi memory stack.
The default LLM provider is OpenRouter with OpenAI as fallback.
Luv prefers tabs in Biome output for the whole monorepo.
Memory kinds include fact, preference, decision, task, relationship, and event.
The standing decision is that ingest runs on Cloudflare Workflows.
yumeoi stores per-user memories inside a Durable Object.
Anna is the manager of the Aurora project at the company.
Luv prefers Effect Schema over zod for the domain package.
Documents are truth and are never deleted by the decay sweep.
The team will use markdown recall lines instead of JSON dumps.
R2 holds raw markdown for documents under the user prefix.
Luv likes short m_ ids because they spend fewer tokens.
MCP OAuth uses the Workers OAuth provider for agent clients.
The favorite local runtime for unit tests is bun test in packages.
Going with one remember write path for ingest and agent writes.
On 2026-09-03 Luv and Anna agreed to ship M4 before Gmail.
Yesterday the team reviewed the v0 plan in a long meeting.
The kickoff meeting is scheduled tomorrow at 10:00 for yumeoi.
Luv needs to ship the M1 extract eval this week without fail.
This morning Luv decided to pin extract to Luna high effort.
Last week Anna presented Aurora status to the wider team.
On 2026-08-30 Luv ingested the first Notion pages into yumeoi.
The todo is wiring POST /ingest to IngestWorkflow before Friday.
Yesterday we chose Cloudflare Workflows for durable ingest steps.
A design review is scheduled for next Tuesday about recall packing.
Luv should finish the recall baseline before changing retrieval.
On 2026-09-08 the keyed OpenRouter eval pinned Luna high extract.
At the meeting Luv agreed to keep documents as the source of truth.
Tomorrow Luv flies to Lisbon for a short offsite about memory v1.
Need to add the Gmail connector in M5 after the memory model lands.
Yesterday Cursor agents shipped the P0 recall harness and D1 fixes.
On 2026-09-01 the team agreed to replace remaining v0 milestones.
Luv must file the types eval set before merging the P1 branch.
This morning the Vectorize emulator returned empty matches in workerd.
Last week we reviewed three facts that change over time in the corpus.
The task for today is recording heuristic classification accuracy.
On 2026-07-12 Anna and Luv met about Project Aurora staffing.
Yesterday Luv decided to add merge and contradicts consolidation actions.
A sync meeting is scheduled tomorrow to talk through reindex batches.
Luv needs to provision type, state, eventAt, and validTo metadata indexes.
On 2026-09-04 the preview deploy failed because Vectorize indexes lagged.
At 14:30 yesterday the consolidator returned duplicate for the oat-milk note.
When deploying yumeoi, run `bun run deploy:dry-run` before `deploy:prod`.
Always cite memories with numbered marks like [n] in packed recall.
How to reindex Vectorize: call MemoryAgent.reindex in slices of 500 rows.
Never put Effect imports inside React route modules in this repo.
Every Monday run the decay sweep so dormant rows leave default recall.
Steps to ingest a Notion page: fetch, normalize, chunk, embed, extract, commit.
Always use sql.in when hydrating memories by id so recall stays batched.
When a candidate is older, store it superseded instead of overwriting the present.
How to classify a statement: procedural first, else episodic if timed, else semantic.
Each week refresh the recall eval markdown after retrieval changes land.
Run `bun test packages` before opening a memory-stack pull request.
Must cite the source document when an agent answers from packed memories.
When deploying, the procedure is to provision Vectorize metadata indexes first.
Always prefer hash embeddings in CI so evals stay deterministic without keys.
Every day the source agent should poll connected Notion workspaces for changes.
How to forget a memory: mark forgotten, wait thirty days, then hard delete.
Required to run biome check --write so tabs and imports stay consistent.
Steps to remember a paragraph: classify or extract, embed, consolidate, commit.
Never merge two person entities on embedding similarity alone in the resolver.
When extracting, return empty entities and relations arrays if none are present.
Recurring habit: after each ingest, log how many memories lost their provenance.
How to query as-of: filter observed_at and validity around the requested time T.
Always run the local Vectorize emulator tests in workerd for reindex deletes.
When consolidating, use merge if the candidate only adds detail to the same fact.
Each week back up eval markdown so live numbers are not lost across phases.
The procedure for a new store is migrate 0004, provision indexes, then reindex.
